pr.body: Added iterative cursor fetching in client.js. The first /items request has an empty query; subsequent requests carry the exact next_cursor. Stops when next_cursor is null or absent. README documents this behavior; tests verify initial omission, opaque cursor forwarding, page order, and absent cursor termination. npm test passes (5/5); git diff --check passes. Assumption: API page order is the required item id order.
pr.summary: Made listItems fetch all item pages while preserving API order. Before: only the first page was returned; now: cursors are forwarded unchanged through the final page.

Added pagination and invalid-input tests in test_api.py and documented the contract in README.md. Assumption: emitted cursors are decimal item IDs; only IDs present in the catalogue are accepted. pr.summary: Added cursor pagination for GET /items. Callers can now fetch ordered pages using limit and next_cursor. Before: all 57 items returned in one response; now: 20 by default, with validated cursor continuation and null at the end.
